messages.en: They've been married for ten years, and he still loves his wife just as much as ever, doesn't he?
Yeah, he cooks her favourite food every week.

collocations.en: love you with all my heart

messages.en: We've been together for so long, but I still love you, you know.
I love you too. Let's eat out tonight.
Hey, have you written your own song already?
Yeah, just one so far. I'll send it to you later, okay?

senses.en_definition: To make an effort to do or achieve something.
To try, sample, or try on something to assess its quality, taste, suitability, or fit.
To put an ability, one's luck, someone's loyalty, or something similar to the test.

messages.en: Trying out this new recipe is actually pretty fun. My soy sauce chicken finally turned out right 😂
Wow, that looks delicious! Share the recipe—I want to try it this weekend too.
